item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02865","case1_error":"Uses four bags as four peanuts, omitting the 30 peanuts per bag.","case2_error":"Treats five loaves as five days, then treats 12 slices per loaf as 12 days per loaf.","reason":"Case 1 omits a quantity conversion; case 2 substitutes incompatible quantities and units in its duration calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02866","case1_error":"Leading answer 21 contradicts the correct derivation yielding 29; only an answer conflict is shown.","case2_error":"Evaluates 200 − 60 − 56 as 184 instead of 84.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02867","case1_error":"Equates the remaining two patients' total to 25 − 6, contradicts the given six sessions, then doubles that total.","case2_error":"Evaluates 9 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 + 8 as 49 instead of 51.","reason":"Case 1 introduces invalid relations and double-counts a group total; case 2 numerically miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02868","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly listed calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 2500 after correct formulas that yield 4500.","reason":"Case 1 shows a specific numerical evaluation error; case 2 shows no numerical evaluation supporting its incorrect final number.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02869","case1_error":"Computes normal time minus delayed time for 'how much longer,' producing −24 despite a correct closing sentence.","case2_error":"Omits the original $10,000 purchase from total expenditure, subtracting resale proceeds only from the second ring's cost.","reason":"Case 1 reverses the subtraction defining the requested increase; case 2 leaves an expense out of the net-cost calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
